cues.t: for the first time japanese researchers have conducted a real-life experiment
that shows how some traffic jams appear for no apparent reason they placed 22 vehicles on a single
track and asked the drivers to cruise around at a constant speed of 30 kilometers an hour
at first traffic moved smoothly but soon the distance between cars started to
vary and vehicles clumped together at one point on the track the jam spread
backwards around the track like a shock wave at a rate of about 20 kilometers an
